title_en: Fall 2026 Approval of Other-Department and Undergraduate Courses for Completion Credits
summary: Graduate students of the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering (전기정보공학부) who wish to have graduate courses offered by other departments, or undergraduate courses, recognized as completion credits must submit the relevant approval application form. The form must bear the academic advisor's seal (stamp) and be submitted to the staff member in Room 319 (the department office, Building 301) between 3 September and 17 September 2026. Students whose courses are judged unlikely to be recognized will be notified individually by SNU official email before the course registration cancellation deadline.
applies_to: Graduate students of the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering who wish to have (a) graduate courses offered by a department other than Electrical and Computer Engineering, or (b) undergraduate (학사과정) courses, recognized as completion credits. Submission is required for each such course registered in the current semester (Fall 2026) if the student wants it recognized. Students who did not submit for such a course taken in a previous semester may submit a late application with their advisor's approval. Credit limits differ for students admitted in 2020 or earlier and those admitted in 2021 or later.

dates.what: Submission period for the approval application forms (other-department courses and undergraduate courses)
Individual notification by SNU official email to students whose courses are judged unlikely to be recognized as completion credits (exact date not stated in the notice)
dates.when: Before the course registration cancellation deadline

conditions: The application form must include the academic advisor's seal (stamp).
After internal review, students whose courses are judged unlikely to be recognized will be notified individually by SNU official email before the course registration cancellation deadline.
Only courses similar to Electrical and Computer Engineering offered by the College of Engineering or the College of Natural Sciences (e.g. physics, mathematics) may be applied for.
Unrelated courses (e.g. physical education, arts, social sciences) are not recognized as completion credits but are still included in the grade point average.
Students admitted in 2020 or earlier: other-department and undergraduate courses combined are recognized only up to one half of the completion credits required for their program.
Students admitted in 2021 or later: other-department and undergraduate courses combined are recognized only up to (completion credits required for the program − thesis research credits) × 1/2.
Graduate Electrical and Computer Engineering course credits (excluding thesis research) must exceed the combined credits of other-department and undergraduate courses.

Example: a master's program requires 24 credits; with 6 credits of thesis research, at most 9 credits of other-department and undergraduate courses combined are recognized, and at least 9 major credits must be completed.
Other-department courses do not count toward the qualifying requirement for the thesis submission qualification examination (6 major credits).

Other-department courses are not recognized as Electrical and Computer Engineering graduate course credits at completion; they count only as general completion credits and are included in the grade point average.

Undergraduate courses are recognized up to 6 credits in total across all graduate programs; for example, a doctoral student who already had 6 undergraduate credits recognized during the master's program cannot have further undergraduate courses recognized.

In principle, the form must be submitted for courses registered in the current semester; if a form was not submitted for a course taken in a previous semester, a late application may be submitted with the advisor's approval, marked 사후신청 (late application) at the top left of the form.
steps: Read the related notices linked in the original notice (관련공지1, 관련공지2); their content was not included in this text and was not read.
Download the appropriate attached form: 타학과 교과목 이수 승인신청서(대학원생용).hwp for other-department graduate courses, or 학사과정 교과목 이수 승인신청서(대학원생용).hwp for undergraduate courses. The form contents were not read.

Complete the form and obtain your academic advisor's seal (stamp) on it. For a late application for a course taken in a previous semester, obtain the advisor's approval and write 사후신청 at the top left of the form.
Submit the completed form to the staff member in Room 319, Building 301 (the department office) between 3 and 17 September 2026.
Check your SNU official email for any notice, before the course registration cancellation deadline, that your course may not be recognized.
translation:
Fall 2026 Application for Approval of Other-Department and Undergraduate Courses

★ Key Points
- Submission period: Thursday 3 September 2026 to Thursday 17 September 2026
- Submission method: Complete the attached application form (including the academic advisor's seal (stamp)) and submit it to the staff member in charge in Room 319.
※ After internal review, if it is judged difficult to recognize the course as completion credits, the student concerned will be notified individually by SNU official email before the course registration cancellation deadline.

★ Application for Approval of Other-Department Courses (타학과 교과목 이수 승인신청서)
1) Submit this form if you are a graduate student and wish to have graduate courses offered by a department (school) other than the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering (전기정보공학부) recognized as completion credits.

2) Recognizable credits
- Only courses offered by the College of Engineering or the College of Natural Sciences (physics, mathematics, etc.) that are similar to Electrical and Computer Engineering may be applied for. (Unrelated courses are not recognized, but they are included in the grade point average (e.g. physical education, arts, social sciences).)
- For students admitted in 2020 or earlier, other-department and undergraduate courses combined may be recognized as completion credits only up to one half of the completion credits required for the program.
- For students admitted in 2021 or later, other-department and undergraduate courses may be recognized only up to (completion credits required for the program − thesis research credits) × 1/2.
 * However, credits from graduate Electrical and Computer Engineering courses (excluding thesis research) must be greater than credits from other-department and undergraduate courses.
 ※ Example: For a master's program, the required completion credits are 24. If you have taken 6 credits of graduate thesis research, other-department and undergraduate courses combined are recognized only up to 9 credits, and you must complete at least 9 credits in your major.
- Reference: link (related notice 1), link (related notice 2) [the linked notices were not read]

3) Scope of recognition
- Not recognized toward the qualifying requirement for the thesis submission qualification examination (6 major credits); not recognized as Electrical and Computer Engineering graduate course credits at completion.
- Recognized as general completion credits; included in the grade point average.

3) Notes
- In principle, the form must be submitted for courses registered in the current semester. However, if you failed to submit the form for a course taken in a previous semester, you may additionally submit the form with your academic advisor's approval (you must write the words 사후신청 (late application) at the top left of the form).

★ Application for Approval of Undergraduate Courses (학사과정 교과목 이수 승인신청서; formerly 학부과목 이수 승인신청서)
1) Submit this form if you are a graduate student and wish to have undergraduate courses recognized as completion credits.

2) Recognizable credits
- Up to 6 credits may be recognized in total across all graduate programs.
 ※ Example: If a doctoral student had 6 credits of undergraduate courses recognized as graduate completion credits during the master's program, undergraduate courses cannot be recognized as completion credits during the doctoral program.
- Only courses offered by the College of Engineering or the College of Natural Sciences (physics, mathematics, etc.) that are similar to Electrical and Computer Engineering may be applied for. (Unrelated courses are not recognized, but they are included in the grade point average (e.g. physical education, arts, social sciences).)
- For students admitted in 2020 or earlier, other-department and undergraduate courses combined may be recognized as completion credits only up to one half of the completion credits required for the program.
- For students admitted in 2021 or later, other-department and undergraduate courses may be recognized only up to (completion credits required for the program − thesis research credits) × 1/2.
 * However, credits from graduate Electrical and Computer Engineering courses (excluding thesis research) must be greater than credits from other-department and undergraduate courses.
 ※ Example: For a master's program, the required completion credits are 24. If you have taken 6 credits of graduate thesis research, other-department and undergraduate courses combined are recognized only up to 9 credits, and you must complete at least 9 credits in your major.
- Reference: link (related notice 1), link (related notice 2) [the linked notices were not read]

(Reference)
- Attachments: Application for Approval of Other-Department Courses, Application for Approval of Undergraduate Courses
- Inquiries: Department office (Building 301, Room 319). The contact person and email address are given in the original notice.
